_doc: Example intake for tools/prepare-images.mjs. source_dir is relative to this file. Purposes: hero, illustration, diagram, render, portrait, logo. A caption says what the image is (illustrative, diagram, render), never what the medicine does. Portraits need person, authorised, authorised_by and authorised_on. Decorative images set decorative: true and have no alt text.

images.alt: Softgel capsules beside a diagram of lipid droplets
images.caption: Illustration of a lipid-based softgel formulation (not to scale).

images.authorised_by: name of the person who authorised it
